svg.title: Issue 1 — Page 8 — Panel 3: Luma scans Jink — care and resilience
svg.desc: Medium shot at eye level, wide framing (35mm). In gutter littered with debris + dead leaves at fairy scale, Luma kneels beside Jink. Luma — sapphire-violet suit, single thick braid, cracked left holographic lens prismatic flare — holds med scanner projecting blue-violet holographic readout over Jink's torso, geometric lines tracing ribs/spine. Jink — emerald scuffed, sits on dead leaf, legs out, one hand braced behind, grinning despite pain. Around them: gutter debris, twigs, soot, wreckage shards. LUMA: "Hold still. I need to check your ribs." JINK: "They're where I left them." LUMA: "Two are cracked. Hold still." JINK: "Where are we?" LUMA: "I don't know yet. Hold *still.*"
